languageData.HostTentacleNeed.label: tentacle dependence
languageData.HostTentacleNeed.description: Individuals who have been fully converted into tentacle Hosts can no longer survive without a pool of Amor Squirmers in their body. The Host has a physical and psychological dependence on their presence, as they manage the Host's basic body functions, provide structural rigidity, adjust their mood, etc. The Host can also use their stored pool of tentacles as a resource for various abilities, but should their pool be depleted, they will die unless the supply is replenished.
languageData.RJWGenes_AmorTentacleInfestedFemaleGenit: Carriers of this gene have female genitalia permantly inhabited by tentacles.
languageData.RJWGenes_AmorTentacleInfestedMaleGenital: Carriers of this gene have male genitalia permantly inhabited by tentacles.
languageData.AmorQueenHostBody.label: Amor Queen
languageData.AmorQueenHostBody.description: Carriers of this gene have a body that has been turned into a holding vessel for Amor Squirmer tentacles and a breeding nest for Amor Brood Mother eggs. They also secrete Tentacle Slime.
languageData.AmorBaronessHostBody.label: Amor Baroness
languageData.AmorBaronessHostBody.description: Carriers of this gene have a body that has been turned into a holding vessel for Amor Squirmer tentacles. They can efficiently store and transfer tentacles to other Hosts.
languageData.AmorNymphHostBody.label: Amor Nymph
languageData.AmorNymphHostBody.description: Carriers of this gene have a body that has been turned into a holding vessel for Amor Squirmer tentacles. They can seduce and incapacitate hostile pawns and placate allies in a mental break.
languageData.AmorBaronHostBody.label: Amor Baron
languageData.AmorBaronHostBody.description: Carriers of this gene have a body that has been turned into a holding vessel for Amor Squirmer tentacles. They can protect the colony with defensive buffs and auras.
languageData.AmorRogueHostBody.label: Amor Rogue
languageData.AmorRogueHostBody.description: Carriers of this gene have a body that has been turned into a holding vessel for Amor Squirmer tentacles. They can defend the colony by utilising temporary invisibility.
languageData.AmorKnightHostBody.label: Amor Knight
languageData.AmorKnightHostBody.description: Carriers of this gene have a body that has been turned into a holding vessel for Amor Squirmer tentacles. They can fight for the colony using advanced martial prowess.
languageData.AmorServantHostBody.label: Amor Servant
languageData.AmorServantHostBody.description: Carriers of this gene have a body that has been turned into a holding vessel for Amor Squirmer tentacles. They can support the colony by efficiently performing menial labor.
